New all_writers.v7 descriptor binds complete new native/source/coordinator definitions and real participants before lifecycle.
release_and_backup: Release is immutable original completion metadata, not a reconstructed source or a projector checkpoint. Rebuildability of generic Event indexes does not make compact original receipt/certification custody rebuildable.
